command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-app-catalog-current-utm-qemu.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-program-catalog --program-catalog-path <each of the 70 upstream/pinned/Apps/**/*.ZC paths>
target: UTM-bundled QEMU / PCI ARM64 graphical guest, HVF, one vCPU
scope: Compile-only inventory of all 70 pinned Apps .ZC sources in their app loader contexts. ToTheFront and X-Caliber normal loaders also passed. This does not prove runtime behavior for every app.
scope_note: Compile acceptance only. The separate all-program catalog also includes x86-only network drivers and other expected exclusions; this app-only run isolates the 70 Apps sources and exits cleanly.
